fill.about: Roundabouts Consignments has been a part of Columbia's resale scene since 2003. We provide a quick, convenient way to sell your gently-used furniture, home decor, and clothing in a department store-like atmosphere. We offer our shoppers a huge selection of items to choose from; all at very affordable prices.
